relationships.subject: CGRP antagonists
relationships.evidence_quote: All agents displayed significant efficacy compared with placebo, measured by reduction in mean monthly migraine days (MMD).

key_findings: Review of 12 RCTs: CGRP antagonists (rimegepant, ubrogepant, eptinezumab, erenumab, fremanezumab, galcanezumab) were efficacious and well tolerated for migraine.
